from z3 import Solver, Bool, Sum, And, Or, Not, sat

# Try bipartite graph with parts of size 14 and 14
n1 = 14
n2 = 14

# Variables: x[i][j] for i in 0..13, j in 0..13
x = [[Bool(f"x_{i}_{j}") for j in range(n2)] for i in range(n1)]

s = Solver()

# Row sums between 4 and 7
for i in range(n1):
    rs = Sum([x[i][j] for j in range(n2)])
    s.add(rs >= 4, rs <= 7)

# Column sums between 4 and 7
for j in range(n2):
    cs = Sum([x[i][j] for i in range(n1)])
    s.add(cs >= 4, cs <= 7)

# No 2x2 submatrix of all 1s (forbids 4-cycles)
for i1 in range(n1):
    for i2 in range(i1+1, n1):
        for j1 in range(n2):
            for j2 in range(j1+1, n2):
                s.add(Sum([x[i1][j1], x[i1][j2], x[i2][j1], x[i2][j2]]) <= 3)

print("Number of constraints:", len(s.assertions()))
print("Solving...")
res = s.check()
print("Result:", res)
